critique: The note proves the formerly unresolved weighted Gaussian transport theorem, so the projection identity, exact improvement criterion, joint CLT, conservative studentizer, and Wald coverage are not deferred to a conjecture. Public theorem text for Li–Zhao already provides general block-adaptive IPW and martingale inference, making the new contribution specifically the soft-tilt transport, projection formula, and logged-pair matrix completion rather than adaptive inference itself. Any characterization as separate carryover-effect inference would overstate the result: the estimand is a sustained two-period direct-and-spillover contrast under imposed lag-one memory, and contemporaneous and carryover effects are not separately identified. The efficiency conclusion is asymptotic in growing G, depends on three stabilization conditions, and uses an unobservable population matrix P, while the martingale-CLT leaf should be tied to the exact Brown or Hall–Heyde result rather than attributed only indirectly through Li–Zhao.
